name: AMC High Contrast
description: An accessibility-first style: every text pair meets WCAG AAA (7:1), thick offset focus rings, underlined links, a visible border on every control, alerts marked by a thick start border and a symbol, and no shadows or gradients.
helpText: Light style built on Vita for users who need strong contrast. All text pairs (body, region, muted, links, button text, badge text, alert text) are at least 7:1 (WCAG AAA). Focus is a 3px outline with a 2px offset (yellow inside the dark header). Links in content are underlined, controls have dark 1px borders, and shadows and gradients are removed. Alerts get a thick start border and, when the alert has no icon, a symbol before the title, so meaning is not carried by color alone. Report and badge refinements target Universal Theme classes and should be checked on a live page.
